greet.speaker: Pisces
greet.text: A [Necromancer], yes — and before your hand drifts to that sword, no, nothing in this square has been raised. I merely occupy the cheapest air the Guild permits. Pisces Jealnv. You reek of a body that has never once held mana. Curious. You want something.

text_variants.text: The pupil returns. Your channels are... adequate now. Do try not to embarrass the discipline in public.
Back again. Either you are braver than the Watch or you have reconsidered your ignorance. Which is it?

options.text: You're a mage. Teach me to cast.

options._comment: stage-2 hub topic, lifted verbatim from docs/design/social-2-staging/pisces_stages.json (staging_note/_flag stripped). CANON tread-light: father a [Fencer] is staged (mild); the sold-rapier line is an OBLIQUE Wistram-era nod. HARD RAILS (absolute, per the companion doc): no expulsion cause, no deaths, no Az'kerash, no Ceria specifics. Appended AFTER 'Never mind.' (array end) so it can never shift an earlier option's visible index.
options.text: You hold yourself like a swordsman, not a scholar.

options._comment: (spec §1 beat 2, the 3-path mage-consult opener) Requires door_chain_started (Erin's flicker beat, erin_errand.json), hide_when door_understood (the shared convergence counter -- 3-path identity rule) so it stops offering once ANY leg resolves. Appended at array END (index-safety convention, matches pisces_fence above).
options.text: Something's come through our pantry door. Will you look at it?

options._comment: The SKILL leg's REPORT step (cisterns_scout/wrong_order precedent -- [Observe]-ing pantry_door_runes in the inn alone only banks the intermediate read_the_door_runes; reporting the finding here banks the shared door_understood + pedestal_unsealed). The player's own line restates Pisces's TALK-leg verdict verbatim (consult_talk_done below) -- deliberate identity-rule parity, both legs arrive at the SAME understanding.
options.text: I read the wardwork myself: a spatial anchor, something that remembers being elsewhere.

options._comment: Sequence-break rescue + recap: the ruin pointer used to live ONLY inside the three consult responses -- a player who cleared rift_vermin_leak BEFORE consulting (its on_victory banks door_understood, hiding both consult options) never heard where the anchor stone is and stalled. Gated on the understanding existing, retired once the stone is recovered; APPENDED LAST so existing visible-option numbering (QA scripts press numbers) is untouched.
options.text: About the pantry door -- I understand what it is now. Where does that leave me?

options._comment: The post-recovery pointer (the second sequence-gap a real playthrough hit): once the stone + catalyst are both in hand every other door option has retired, and the awakening's sleep-study window is OPAQUE by design -- this is the one line allowed to say 'rest' without counting anything. Appended LAST (numbering safety); retires at door_awakened.
options.text: I have the stone and Krshia's catalyst. Now what?

door_consult.speaker: Pisces
door_consult.text: A door that changes its mind about where it goes. How very like this city -- even the fixtures have moods. Three ways to satisfy my curiosity: bleed for it, talk me into caring, or prove you can read a ward without my help. Choose, and don't waste my morning.

options.text: I'll clear whatever's coming through myself.
Come look at it yourself. Your kind of magic, not mine.
I'll read the wardwork myself, then.

consult_fight_response.speaker: Pisces
consult_fight_response.text: Bleeding it is. Predictable, but effective. Go on, then. I'll be here, dry and uninjured, exactly as planned.

consult_talk_pitch.speaker: Pisces
consult_talk_pitch.text: You want me to walk into someone's pantry and grope at a wild ward with my bare senses. No. I have wards of my own I'd rather keep.

options.text: It's not asking much. You'd know in a glance.

consult_talk_argue.speaker: Pisces
consult_talk_argue.text: ...A glance. Hm. If it truly reads as spatial and not necrotic, I could examine it without touching a thing. Fine, for the intellectual insult of not knowing, not for you.
consult_talk_argue._comment: sweep-caught re-pricing: this TALK-leg close was a free ungated persuade resolving the door_that_goes_elsewhere quest fork (banks persuaded_someone + door_understood + pedestal_unsealed) -- same rule as the four named quests. Split Diplomat-gated free vs a paid alternate (Pisces is mercenary/vain, not bribe-averse like Zevara, so a flat consultation fee reads honest); both converge on the SAME consult_talk_done (Pisces reacting to what he found, not to how he was won over, so it fits either branch).

options.text: Then it's settled -- I'll cover your time instead. (5 gold)

consult_talk_done.speaker: Pisces
consult_talk_done.text: A spatial anchor. Crude. Fascinating. Whoever built your inn, adventurer, built it on something that remembers being elsewhere.

consult_skill_response.speaker: Pisces
consult_skill_response.text: Read it yourself, then. [Observe] the frame close, and mind that the pattern doesn't repeat the same way twice. Report back if you actually understand what you saw. I'll judge whether you do.

consult_skill_report.speaker: Pisces
consult_skill_report.text: ...Correct. Aggravatingly correct. You have the eye, if not the training. Don't let it go to your head. The training is where the real work is.

pisces_fence.speaker: Pisces
pisces_fence.text: ...Observant. A rapier, in fact, before any of this. My father's trade — his grip, his footwork, his opinions on both. I set it down for magic, and he has yet to forgive either of us. The footwork stayed. It wins me arguments the diction loses.

pisces_fence_two.speaker: Pisces
pisces_fence_two.text: I sold the blade years ago, when circumstances were... instructive. One does not miss a thing so much as the hands remember it. A sniff. Next question — preferably about magic, which unlike the past improves under examination.

lesson_mana.speaker: Pisces
lesson_mana.text: Then attend. Every living thing carries a reserve — mana. You will feel it as a second breath: a well that empties as you work a spell and refills when you sleep. A warrior spends stamina; you now spend this. Waste it and you are left waving your hands at the air.

options.text: How is casting different from swinging a blade?

lesson_casting.speaker: Pisces
lesson_casting.text: A sword asks only your arm. A spell asks your mind and your mana in the same instant: intent, shape, and cost, released together or not at all. Fumble any one of the three and you have merely gestured. Precision, traveler. Whatever the Watch mutters about my craft, it taught me precision.

options.text: So what do I cast first?

lesson_light.speaker: Pisces
lesson_light.text: [Light]. Always [Light]. It is cheap, it is obedient, and it fails without a corpse, a fire, or an inquest. Kindle one steady orb and you have proven the channel holds. Master that, and only then do we discuss the interesting spells.

options.text: I'm ready. Show me the words.

sealed.speaker: Pisces
sealed.text: There. The channel is opened — crudely, but opened. Sleep on it; the shape settles by morning, as these things do. And, traveler, when your first orb kindles, you will understand why I do not apologize for what I am.

door_recap.speaker: Pisces
door_recap.text: Then attend, because I dislike repeating myself. The door remembers being elsewhere; it wants an anchor to remember BY. East across the floodplains, well past the gate road, there is a seam of old dressed stone in the open grass -- a ruin, collapsed and rude, but its plinth still cradles an anchor stone. Retrieve it. Krshia's resonant catalyst will attune the pairing. And do try not to die somewhere so architecturally disappointing.

options.text: East past the gate road. Understood.

door_recap_two.speaker: Pisces
door_recap_two.text: I have STANDARDS, not an itinerary. The Guild survey called it a seam and moved on; I call it a doorframe that lost its house. Go and prove one of us right.

door_attune.speaker: Pisces
door_attune.text: Then the scholarship is done and the tedium begins. Keep both near the door and REST. Attunement is not a lever, it is a residency -- the frame learns the stone the way a house learns its family: overnight, and more than once. Sleep. Let the inn do the part no [Mage] can rush.

options.text: Sleep on it. Literally. Got it.
